mapper.select: select orders.order_id, orders.time, order_details.id, order_details.comment, order_details.totals, order_details.number, product.p_name, product.picture_name, product.p_describe, product.pd_id, IF(order_details.number = 0, NULL, (order_details.totals / order_details.number)) AS unit_price from orders join order_details on orders.order_id = order_details.order_id join product on order_details.pd_id = product.pd_id where orders.state = 'finish' and orders.uid = #{uid} and order_details.comment = '0';
